    out = b''
    out += struct.pack('<H', 0x8664)   # f_magic AMD64
    out += struct.pack('<H', nscns)    # f_nscns
    out += struct.pack('<I', 0)        # f_timdat
    out += struct.pack('<I', 0)        # f_symptr
    out += struct.pack('<I', 0)        # f_nsyms
    out += struct.pack('<H', opthdr)   # f_opthdr
    out += struct.pack('<H', flags)    # f_flags (F_EXEC)
    if opthdr:
        # PE32+ optional header magic, rest pad
        out += struct.pack('<H', 0x20b) + opthdr_fill * (opthdr-2)
    for i in range(nscns):
        s = b''
        s += b'.text\x00\x00\x00'
        s += struct.pack('<I', 0)
        s += struct.pack('<I', 0)
        s += struct.pack('<I', 0)
        s += struct.pack('<I', 0)
        s += struct.pack('<I', 0)
        s += struct.pack('<I', 0)
        s += struct.pack('<H', 0)
        s += struct.pack('<H', 0)
        s += struct.pack('<I', 0x20)   # STYP_TEXT
        out += s
    open(path, 'wb').write(out)

	 __executable_start for __ImageBase to support R_AMD64_IMAGEBASE
	 relocation which is relative to __ImageBase.  */
      struct bfd_link_hash_entry *h, *hi;
      hi = bfd_link_hash_lookup (info->hash, "__ImageBase", true, false,
				 false);
      if (hi->type == bfd_link_hash_new
	  || hi->type == bfd_link_hash_undefined
	  || hi->type == bfd_link_hash_undefweak)
	{
	  h = bfd_link_hash_lookup (info->hash, "__executable_start",
				    true, false, true);
	  hi->type = bfd_link_hash_indirect;
	  hi->u.i.link = h;
	}
    }

  return _bfd_coff_link_add_symbols (abfd, info);
}
